  {
    "testCaseId": "TC_POS_001",
    "title": "Positive Test: Successful LTE Attach and Detach for Multiple UEs",
    "description": "Validate that multiple UEs can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures under excellent radio conditions with 100% success rate for 10 iterations.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Network setup with single LTE cell activated and unloaded; other cells powered off.",
      "Multiple stationary UEs (at least 2) placed under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6).",
      "Test configuration parameters recorded and applied."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Access the 5G management interface and configure the test setup according to specified test configuration.",
      "Confirm that the LTE cell under test is active and unloaded, and other cells are powered off.",
      "Place multiple UEs under excellent LTE radio conditions (close to eNB antenna) ensuring RSRP meets Clause 4.6 criteria.",
      "Start logging to capture call flow and signaling messages.",
      "Power ON all UEs to trigger the LTE attach procedure.",
      "Wait until all UEs successfully complete the attach procedure (validate attach request and attach complete messages).",
      "Power OFF all UEs to trigger the LTE detach procedure.",
      "Wait until all UEs successfully complete the detach procedure (validate detach request and detach accept messages).",
      "Stop logging and save logs for analysis.",
      "Repeat the attach and detach cycle 10 times.",
      "Record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency metrics for each UE."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "All UEs successfully attach and detach 10 consecutive times with 100% success rate.",
      "Attach latency is recorded with minimum, average, and maximum values as per Table 5-5.",
      "Logs confirm UE attached to correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "Test logs saved for reference and measurement.",
      "UEs returned to idle/detached state."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Access 5G management interface (generic)",
      "Start and Stop logging (generic)"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Validate attach and detach signaling messages in logs",
      "Check UE logs/applications for correct cell attachment",
      "Verify KPI metrics match expected success rates and latency"
    ]
  },

    "testCaseId": "TC_NEG_001",
    "title": "Negative Test: Attach Failure Due to Poor Radio Conditions",
    "description": "Validate system behavior when multiple UEs attempt attach under poor radio conditions causing attach failures.",
    "preconditions": [
      "Single LTE or 5G NSA cell activated and unloaded.",
      "Multiple UEs placed under poor radio conditions below minimum RSRP/SS-RSRP thresholds defined in Clause 4.6."
    ],
    "testSteps": [
      "Configure the test environment with the cell active and other cells off.",
      "Place multiple UEs in poor radio conditions using attenuators or fading generator to reduce signal strength below threshold.",
      "Start logging to capture signaling.",
      "Power ON the UEs to initiate attach procedure.",
      "Wait for attach attempts to complete or timeout.",
      "Power OFF UEs (if any attached).",
      "Stop logging and save logs.",
      "Repeat for 10 iterations.",
      "Record attach success rate and latency."
    ],
    "expectedResults": [
      "Attach success rate is below 100%, indicating failures due to poor radio conditions.",
      "Attach latency may be increased or attach may timeout.",
      "Detach procedures may not be performed if attach fails.",
      "Logs show attach request failures or rejections."
    ],
    "postconditions": [
      "UEs remain detached or in failed attach state.",
      "Logs stored for analysis."
    ],
    "commandsUsed": [
      "Access 5G management interface (generic)",
      "Start and Stop logging (generic)"
    ],
    "verificationMethods": [
      "Analyze signaling logs for attach failure messages",
      "Check KPI metrics for reduced attach success rate",
      "Verify no improper attach completions"
    ]
  },
